data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate shows a small gross increase in claims outstanding during 2015: gross claims outstanding rose from nil at 1 January 2015 to 17 (thousand) at 31 December 2015 (i.e. a $0.017m gross strengthening). No specific prior-year adverse development, named catastrophe events or causal explanation for the movement is provided in the notes.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD). Financial statement figures in the report are shown in $'000; values here are converted to millions (e.g. 17 $'000 = 0.017). Opening gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2014 is presented as '-' (treated as zero). The prior year movement is taken from the Technical Provisions table (change in claims outstanding = 17 $'000). No explicit narrative describing prior-year reserve development or causes is provided; the technical provisions table and small claims development table are the only sources. Because the movement line is used (which can include current-year items) confidence is reduced below 1.0.
